blocks.html: Puerto Los Cabos Fishing Charters – San José del Cabo

Experience private fishing charters departing directly from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, Mexico.

Exotic Fish Cabo offers personalized sportfishing trips for visitors looking to explore the productive waters of the Sea of Cortez.

Our marina location provides access to renowned fishing areas including Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, La Fortuna, and nearby coastal fishing grounds.

Depending on the season, anglers can target marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, roosterfish, and other local species.

Choose from private 6-hour or 8-hour fishing adventures with experienced local captains and quality fishing equipment.

The Origins and Vision of Puerto Los Cabos

The history of Puerto Los Cabos Marina is deeply tied to the rise of sportfishing in Baja California Sur. Long before the marina was built, San José del Cabo was a small fishing village where local families relied on the sea for sustenance. As tourism grew in Los Cabos, developers envisioned a marina that would honor this legacy while providing world-class facilities for visiting anglers.

Puerto Los Cabos was created as part of a master-planned community, designed to complement Cabo San Lucas while offering a more tranquil and culturally rooted experience. Its development was guided by respect for the environment and a desire to preserve traditions. The marina stands today as a bridge between past and present: a place where artisanal fishing culture meets modern sportfishing tournaments.

Fishing Opportunities in Puerto Los Cabos

The waters surrounding Puerto Los Cabos are among the richest in the world, offering year-round opportunities for anglers. The marina serves as the launch point for unforgettable fishing charters, tournaments, and private expeditions.

  • Inshore Fishing: Roosterfish, snapper, and jacks thrive along the coastline, providing thrilling action close to shore.

  • Offshore Fishing: Marlin, sailfish, dorado, and tuna dominate the deeper waters, attracting anglers from across the globe.

  • Seasonal Highlights: Summer and fall bring peak marlin runs, while winter offers excellent tuna and wahoo fishing.

Located on the Sea of Cortez side of Los Cabos, Puerto Los Cabos Marina offers a convenient departure point for private sportfishing adventures.

Anglers can explore coastal and offshore fishing grounds, including Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and other productive areas when weather and ocean conditions permit.

Whether you're targeting marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, or roosterfish, our experienced local captains tailor each trip to seasonal fishing opportunities and your group's preferences.

Cultural and Economic Impact

Puerto Los Cabos Marina is not only a fishing hub—it is a cornerstone of San José del Cabo’s identity. It supports restaurants, shops, and cultural events, while serving as a gathering place for locals and visitors alike. The marina has become an economic engine, driving tourism and creating opportunities for local businesses.

At the same time, it remains a cultural anchor. Fishing tournaments, community festivals, and traditional celebrations keep alive the spirit of San José del Cabo. For many, Puerto Los Cabos is more than a marina—it is a symbol of resilience, authenticity, and the enduring bond between the people of Baja California Sur and the sea.

Why Puerto Los Cabos Stands Out

What makes Puerto Los Cabos unique is its balance between modern amenities and cultural authenticity. While it offers state-of-the-art facilities for yachts and sportfishing charters, it also preserves the traditions of local fishermen. Visitors can experience both worlds: the excitement of world-class fishing and the charm of a community deeply connected to its maritime roots.

For anglers, Puerto Los Cabos is a dream destination. For travelers, it is a gateway to understanding the history and culture of Los Cabos. And for locals, it is a proud symbol of their heritage, standing as proof that tradition and progress can coexist.

Plan Your Puerto Los Cabos Fishing Trip

Planning a fishing trip in San José del Cabo? Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina.

Our fishing trips normally depart at 6:30 AM. All departures take place from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, not Cabo San Lucas Marina.

Visitors staying in Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, or elsewhere in Los Cabos are welcome to book. Please arrange transportation to the departure marina and confirm your meeting instructions before your trip.

Our private fishing charters include an experienced local captain, crew, and fishing equipment. Additional arrangements, including licenses, bait, food, and drinks, can be confirmed when booking.

Explore our private fishing charter options to compare trip durations, prices, and booking information.
